name: Ma
reference: Kenya Hara's MUJI work and the Japanese idea of ma, meaningful emptiness.
pattern: Warm paper, charcoal type, one unbleached natural tone as a block.
personality: Silence. One small word or image in a large empty field, held long.

motion.character: Very slow fades of 1.5-2.5 s and long holds. Nothing bounces, nothing hurries.
motion.transitions: A slow dissolve through the paper.

grammar: At least 70 % of the frame is empty.
One word, one line or one small image per scene.
Type is small and widely spaced; size never shouts.
The natural-tone block may hold the one image.

pictures.note: A quiet plate (a moving shadow, a wall, light on paper) fills the frame as the field, and the line sits on its calm part; an object sits small in a large empty field. Held long; muted, warm, soft.

footage.note: A small, slow, nearly still clip: water, leaves, light on paper.

music.feel: sparse ambient piano, long silences, calm

hits.note: No effects: silence is part of the design.

compose.how: A small picture in a large field of paper: the picture at the size its hook asks (about 40 % of the frame's width, at least 8 % of the frame; heroBox with area: 0.1), set off centre on a third (right of centre, a little above the middle), and the line small (body, the floor size) on the text-safe left, two short rows broken where the sense breaks, a wide gap of paper below the picture. Never a plate that fills the frame, never a card centred on the page. At least 70 % of the frame stays paper.

hook.how: One real thing on frame 0 in a large field of paper: a moving shadow, a plate of a wall, a small object. Never a flat placeholder square.

moves.move: Every entrance and exit is a slow fade through the paper, 1.5-2.5 s; nothing rises out of a mask.

measurable.how: Each text and picture reaches full opacity over 40 frames or more.

moves.move: At least 70 % of the frame is empty paper, and the one image or line sits in it.

measurable.how: The empty share stays at 70 % or more on every key frame.

moves.move: One credit per musical phrase, each in its own silence of paper.

measurable.how: Two texts never share the screen; a gap of 0.5-1 s of paper sits between them.

blocks.for: The one image, at about 40 % of the width.

props.role: "body" for the one line of a beat (it must read on a phone); "caption" or "label" only for a credit

blocks.for: The one line in the field, and small, widely spaced credits.
The long holds that are the design.

props.roomTone: a recording of a quiet room, under the bed from frame 0

blocks.for: The sparse bed, fading with the last dissolve, over a room tone.

avoid.why: A flat square of colour reads as a missing image. Use a real picture.

ends.how: The title dissolves into the paper over about 2 s, and 1 s of paper holds under the last decay of the music. Not a held card.
ends.with: the last line with `until` about 2 s before the end and its exit a fade (the vocabulary); the paper holds

mix.note: Sparse and quiet, with room tone from frame 0. No effects: silence is part of the design.

shots.match: One image. If a second comes, it shares the first one's light and paper tone.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
